description: Na₄Mg(FeO₂)₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.53 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.42 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.56 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.38 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.06 Å. There are four inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-1.96 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-1.93 Å. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.16 Å. In the fourth Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.22 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Fe atoms to form ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₂ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₂ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Fe atoms to form ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₂ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms to form ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂Fe₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgFe₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Fe atoms.
